hints.title: Build the string from left to right
hints.body: At every position you choose either `'('` or `')'`. Which choices are legal after a given prefix? Track how many opening and closing parentheses have been used so far.

hints.title: State the two legality conditions
hints.body: You may add an opening parenthesis while fewer than `n` have been used. You may add a closing parenthesis only while the number used is less than the number of openings used. These conditions prevent invalid prefixes.

hints.title: Stop only at full length
hints.body: When the built string has length `2n`, it is complete and must be recorded. Explore openings before closings so the natural order is lexicographic; sorting at the end also works and is harder to get wrong.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
result = empty list
path = empty list

def build(opened, closed):
    if length(path) == 2 * n:
        append joined path to result
        return
    if opened < n:
        append "(" to path
        build(opened + 1, closed)
        remove last from path
    if closed < opened:
        append ")" to path
        build(opened, closed + 1)
        remove last from path

build(0, 0)
sort result lexicographically
return result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
